g.text: The F wedge is a special three-dimensional case
n = 3, intercept plus slope, one restriction: numerator df = 1 and residual df = 1.
Translate this cross-section along the null line to obtain the wedge.
With more residual or added dimensions, the boundary is a quadratic cone rather than two planes.
